limitations: Applies to finite split-basic algebras with square-zero Jacobson radical, or to finite quiver path algebras modulo paths of length at least two. It does not assert character values or extend to non-square-zero radicals. The known little-group theorem is a crucial standard input. Novelty is best knowledge relative to inspected sources, and a broader torus-by-abelian character formula may imply it.
scientific_integrity: An explicit finite-group character enumeration derived from the abelian normal radical, its diagonal torus stabilizers, and the classical Clifford little-group correspondence. An independent direct group-conjugacy and dual-orbit verifier checks 19 finite configurations; the proof, not the finite cases, supplies universal validity. Self-review only; no independently performed audit or priority certification.
title: Weighted Tutte character spectra of radical-square-zero quiver unit groups
